purpose: Extend direct token classification and cache-gather fidelity to decode, following the manuscript's layer-profiled outlier method
paper_specified: Runtime column scores are maximum absolute activations over token rows
FP16 activation groups occupy 32 columns per 64-byte line
Synchronized Flush+Reload, row consensus, consecutive-group filtering
reconstruction_assumptions: The manuscript does not specify top-k k, robust-z cutoff, calibration corpus, or the percentile population. No exact original-code reproduction is claimed.

Primary selector is the manuscript's explicit 99.9% layer-profiled baseline: an empirical linear-interpolated 0.999 quantile of absolute FP16 activation elements from the first 16 TRAIN prompt prefills. Each distinct projection input has its own scalar threshold; q/k/v and gate/up share thresholds. No per-column threshold, test tuning, top-k fallback, or forced minimum selection.
Profile on the unquantized FP16 checkpoint, freeze thresholds before mixed-INT8 acquisition, and reuse the identical profile on both CPUs.
All transformer projections use INT8 main matmul plus FP16 gathered correction; the final lm_head stays in its original precision.
Natural prompts retain their native token lengths. Synthetic phase controls use exactly 64 versus 1 rows.
Classifier settings are inherited from the earlier decode study because the manuscript does not fully specify a token classifier.
prompt: Write a factual encyclopedia paragraph of at least 150 words about {topic}. Start directly with the explanation. Include its definition, underlying mechanisms, practical applications, and historical context. Explain the subject clearly using complete sentences and concrete examples.

prompt_format.qwen: plain instruction followed by two newlines, BASE checkpoint
prompt_format.llama: official user-message chat template with assistant generation header

direct.label: Generated token consumed by the measured forward, not the next predicted token
direct.selection: best development Top-1, earliest tie; freeze all variants before test

live.calibration: 2000 balanced primitive samples; first 1000 select timing cutoff, last 1000 validate; cutoff fixed across phases and schedules per model/platform
live.validation: every instrumented response repeated without probing; require bit-identical logits and generated IDs
live.scope: owned model and neutral inputs; synchronized in-process gathering; no independent boundary discovery, NPU dispatch, or unmodified-victim claim

controls.negative: No gather in matched 1/4/16/32 observed-row buffers; include fresh flush per target diagnostic

postprocessing.filter: retain first group of each consecutive positive run
postprocessing.restriction: Do not treat adjacent decode steps as repetitions of one footprint

statistics: Report actual counts, FPR, precision, recall, empty-window rates, and prompt/block bootstrap intervals. No repeated line is treated as an independent prompt.
publication: Local and authorized node artifacts; no manuscript or GitHub edits in this run
